name: Failed payment recovery
description: When a charge fails, draft a dunning outreach, gate it behind a human approval, retry the charge through your billing system, and notify the collections channel.

requiredCredentials.name: billing_webhook
requiredCredentials.purpose: Signs the retry-charge call to your billing system

requiredCredentials.name: billing_slack
requiredCredentials.purpose: Posts the recovery outcome to your collections channel

invoiceId.description: Invoice id the failed charge applies to

amountUsd.description: Amount of the failed charge in USD

reason.description: Decline reason reported by the payment processor

config.prompt: You are a billing-recovery assistant. Write a short, friendly dunning message (under 120 words) asking the customer to update their payment method, given a failed charge. Customer: {{context.trigger.output.customer}}, invoice: {{context.trigger.output.invoiceId}}, amount: ${{context.trigger.output.amountUsd}}, decline reason: {{context.trigger.output.reason}}.

input.text: :credit_card: Recovery attempted for {{context.trigger.output.customer}} (invoice {{context.trigger.output.invoiceId}}, ${{context.trigger.output.amountUsd}}). Outreach drafted and charge retried.

failureFixtures.label: Billing credential unavailable
failureFixtures.description: The billing connector cannot resolve its configured credential before the retry starts.

failureFixtures.label: Billing credential expired
failureFixtures.description: The billing provider rejects an expired credential and the charge retry moves into recovery.

errorJson.name: CredentialExpiredError
errorJson.message: billing_webhook credential expired before the retry request

failureFixtures.label: Billing provider rate limited
failureFixtures.description: The billing provider returns HTTP 429 so operators can inspect retry-safe recovery evidence.

errorJson.name: ToolError
errorJson.message: billing retry was rate limited by the upstream provider
